title: UGC Commerce Video Script Plan Schema
description: Schema for structured short-form ecommerce script planning output.

task_type.description: Fixed task type for this schema.

summary.description: Top-level planning summary for the script.

script_objective.description: Primary business goal of the script.

target_audience.description: Audience summary used for message shaping.

main_promise.description: Single dominant message the viewer should remember.

primary_friction_point.description: Main objection, skepticism point, or buying hesitation the script should address.

recommended_format.description: Recommended style such as UGC testimonial, demo-led, comparison, creator recommendation, or routine integration.

tone_note.description: Guidance on voice, creator delivery, or overall message tone.

angle_development.description: Creative angle generation and selection layer.

candidate_angles.description: Possible angle directions considered before choosing the final route.

angle_type.description: Angle category such as pain-first, result-first, comparison, testimonial, or routine.

description.description: What this angle would communicate and how.

why_it_could_work.description: Reason this angle fits the audience, product, or platform.

visual_proof_fit.description: Whether the benefit can be shown clearly in a short video.

risk_note.description: Potential weakness or tradeoff of this angle.

selection_rationale.description: Why this angle was selected over others.

message_hierarchy.description: Hierarchy of what the viewer should understand and believe in sequence.

attention_trigger.description: What should make the viewer stop scrolling.

relevance_signal.description: Why the viewer should feel the video is for them.

main_benefit.description: Primary product payoff emphasized in the script.

supporting_benefits.description: Secondary points that support the main message.

proof_target.description: What claim or belief must be proven in the script.

objection_target.description: Main hesitation the script should reduce.

cta_goal.description: Desired next action from the viewer.

hook_options.description: Candidate openings designed for short-form retention.

hook_type.description: Hook category such as pain, result, mistake, curiosity, comparison, or identity.

visual_pairing.description: Recommended opening visual that should accompany the hook.

reason_it_works.description: Why this hook is likely to stop the right viewer.

tradeoff_note.description: Possible downside or context where this hook is weaker.

selected_hook.description: Chosen opening direction for the final script.

structure_type.description: Framework such as pain-product-proof-cta, result-explain-demo-cta, or testimonial-demo-cta.

structure_rationale.description: Why this structure is appropriate for the product and audience.

estimated_runtime_seconds.description: Target runtime for the planned script.

beat_name.description: Short label such as hook, reveal, demo, proof, objection, or CTA.

message_goal.description: What the viewer should understand, feel, or believe after this beat.

visual_support.description: What should be shown during this beat.

proof_role.description: How this beat contributes proof, reassurance, or credibility.

objection_role.description: If relevant, what hesitation this beat reduces.

timing_note.description: Optional note about pacing or compression.

proof_plan.description: How the script intends to make claims believable.

proof_method.description: Primary proof strategy such as demo, before/after, creator experience, comparison, or close-up detail.

proof_moments.description: Key moments where proof should appear.

proof_priority_note.description: What absolutely must be shown for the script to work.

proof_risk_note.description: What claim may feel weak if proof is missing or unclear.

objection_handling_plan.description: How likely hesitation is addressed in the script.

handling_method.description: How the script responds to the main objection.

handling_beats.description: Beat numbers or beat labels where objection handling happens.

specificity_note.description: How to make the reassurance feel concrete rather than generic.

subtitle_and_overlay_plan.description: Suggested text support plan for mobile-first viewing.

subtitle_style_note.description: General note on subtitle density, tone, or emphasis style.

overlay_priorities.description: Most important phrases that should be visually reinforced.

cta_plan.description: Primary CTA strategy for the script.

cta_type.description: CTA style such as direct action, benefit-led, urgency-led, or trust-led.

cta_fit_note.description: Why this CTA is matched to the persuasion level of the script.

execution_notes.description: Practical guidance for bringing the script to life.

delivery_style.description: How the creator or voice should sound.

visual_style.description: How polished, raw, premium, or natural the visuals should feel.

pacing_note.description: How tightly the lines should be delivered.

must_capture_shots.description: Essential footage or proof shots needed for the script to work.

editing_note.description: Any important post-production or sequence note.

testing_variants.description: Optional structured variations for testing different angles or openings.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made due to missing information.

warnings.description: Important cautions about proof gaps, product fit, or execution risks.

next_steps.description: Suggested follow-up steps such as storyboard creation, prompt conversion, or variant testing.
